occurrence_evidence.claim: Before the incident, Anthropic described log analysis and malware reverse engineering as benign uses intended to be allowed. It acknowledged false-positive blocking within a conservative safety margin.
Hugging Face’s investigation required analysis of thousands of recovered attack actions and hostile artefacts.

Hugging Face reports hosted-model refusals during that analysis. Its later timeline names Claude Opus and Fable and says Opus guardrails repeatedly blocked attack-log inspection. The earlier unnamed account describes the same response-phase restriction.

The team deployed quantized GLM-5.2 on its own infrastructure and rerouted the analysis pipeline. It decoded staged payloads and built trace-analysis interfaces while keeping attacker data on premises.
